To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The Internet is a powerful tool that can be used to enhance learning.

the Internet and the WWW are a new and important source of information, and that the use of the Internet and WWW in higher education is growing rapidly, but that there are still many problems and obstacles to the use of these new technologies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the extent to which e-learning is being used as a tool to facilitate access to tertiary education in the country.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the achievement of universal communications service will facilitate access to tertiary education through e-learning.
the Universal Service Fund is an effective and sustainable mechanism for the actualisation of Universal Service and the realisation of the e-learning objectives in tertiary education.
universal service in telecommunications is a necessary but not sufficient condition for achieving universal access to tertiary education through e-learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
e-learning has come to stay in the tertiary education sector.
e-learning is a viable alternative to the traditional mode of teaching and learning in the tertiary education sector.

the Universal Service Fund (USF) should be used to fund projects in e-learning in order to achieve universal service in communications and to provide access to tertiary education for the underprivileged.
The main takeaway from our work is that
universal access to telecommunications is a necessary condition for e-learning to succeed.
universal service is necessary to achieve the goals of e-learning in the tertiary education sector.
e-learning is a practical way to facilitate access to tertiary education.
